QuestInfo.name: Meaning of Memories 1
QuestInfo.0: Memory Keeper, the one that sees memories, wants to speak with you. Go see Memory Keeper.
QuestInfo.1: Memory Keeper tells you to go find and face memories if you want to accomplish what you want to accomplish. Go face the scattered memories in #b#MDmirrorD_328_0_##k.
QuestInfo.2: You faced the scattered memories in #MDmirrorD_328_0_#.

0.0: What are memories to you? Memories are things that already happened, filled with regret... pain... joy... I can see tragic memories in your past. \r\n#L0##b...What are you going on about? #l\n#k
0.1: Oh, corrupter! You are composed of countless Shards of Recollection. You must face your memories...

yes.0: People must accept their memories as part of them. You, corrupter, you must rediscover your memories. Put on #r#t4009109##k and #r#t4009110##k, then face your memories...

no.0: Remember that you can't exist without your memories.

yes.0: You will grow stronger as you regain more memories.

default.0: Find the #r#t4009109##k and #r#t4009110##k to cover yourself...
